SELECT block_root, received, slot, source, verdict, total_ms, head_ms, exec_ms, before_ms, columns_wait_ms, el_ms, stf_ms, get_head_ms
FROM (
  SELECT
    received, slot, source, verdict, block_root, arrival_ms, attestable_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(exec_start) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(received)) / 1e6 - columns_wait_ms AS before_ms,
    columns_wait_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_done) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(exec_start)) / 1e6 AS exec_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(attestable) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_done)) / 1e6 AS head_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(attestable) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(received)) / 1e6 AS total_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(el_verdict_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(el_sent)) / 1e6 AS el_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_spec_end) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_spec_start)) / 1e6 AS stf_spec_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_done) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_start)) / 1e6 AS stf_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(get_head_end) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(get_head_start)) / 1e6 AS get_head_ms
  FROM (
    SELECT
      block_root,
      maxOrNull(slot) AS slot,
      anyIf(source, stage = 'received') AS source,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'received') AS received,
      minIfOrNull(time_into_slot_ms, stage = 'received') AS arrival_ms,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'el_sent') AS el_sent,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'el_verdict') AS el_verdict_at,
      argMinIf(verdict, event_date_time, stage = 'el_verdict') AS verdict,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'stf_spec_start') AS stf_spec_start,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'stf_spec_end') AS stf_spec_end,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'stf_start') AS stf_start,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'stf_done') AS stf_done,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'attestable') AS attestable,
      minIfOrNull(time_into_slot_ms, stage = 'attestable') AS attestable_ms,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'columns_wait_start') AS columns_wait_start,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'columns_wait_end') AS columns_wait_end,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'get_head_start') AS get_head_start,
      minIfOrNull(event_date_time, stage = 'get_head_end') AS get_head_end,
      coalesce(el_sent, stf_spec_start, stf_start) AS exec_start,
      coalesce((toUnixTimestamp64Nano(columns_wait_end) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(columns_wait_start)) / 1e6, 0) AS columns_wait_ms
    FROM block_events
    WHERE event_date_time BETWEEN toDateTime(1794014739) - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
                              AND toDateTime(1794016539) + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
      AND meta_client_name = 'beacon-eth4'
      AND column_index IS NULL
    GROUP BY block_root
  )
  WHERE received BETWEEN toDateTime(1794014739) AND toDateTime(1794016539) AND attestable IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY received LIMIT 1000

    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(attestable) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_done)) / 1e6 AS head_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(attestable) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(received)) / 1e6 AS total_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(el_verdict_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(el_sent)) / 1e6 AS el_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_spec_end) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_spec_start)) / 1e6 AS stf_spec_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_done) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(stf_start)) / 1e6 AS stf_ms,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(get_head_end) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(get_head_start)) / 1e6 AS get_head_ms
  FROM (
    SELECT
      block_root,

    FROM block_events
    WHERE event_date_time BETWEEN toDateTime(1794014739) - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
                              AND toDateTime(1794016539) + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
      AND meta_client_name = 'beacon-eth5'
      AND column_index IS NULL
    GROUP BY block_root
  )
  WHERE received BETWEEN toDateTime(1794014739) AND toDateTime(1794016539) AND attestable IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY received LIMIT 1000
